text:
Step 1: Determine offsets.  
Asia/Singapore in 1961 used UTC+7:30 (Malaya Standard Time).  
US/Eastern in 1961 used UTC-5 (no DST in winter).  

Step 2: Convert 3 PM = 15:00 Singapore time (UTC+7:30) to UTC.  
UTC = 15:00 - 7:30 = 07:30 UTC same day.  

Step 3: Convert UTC to US/Eastern (UTC-5).  
US/Eastern = 07:30 - 5 = 02:30 same day (Dec 1).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 02:30
